_comment: Example output of lib/domains_generator.py. Copy the generator's real output here as config/domains.json (gitignored, site-specific) after running it against your own BACH install. 'experts[]' is provenance/grouping metadata only -- the ticket-master prompt routes directly to standalone_skill / matched_skills, never to the expert name itself.

experts.name: example-expert-exact
